typography.font_characteristics: modern grotesque; heavy for keywords, regular for support words; often lowercase

dual_tone.rule: Key nouns/verbs in near-black bold; filler words in medium gray. In-frame dual-tone is primary; karaoke pill is slim support.

color.background_treatment: flat light studio gray/off-white; optional subtle dot-grid inset panel
color.accent_usage: single signal color only when needed (never decorative flood)

motion_graphics.zoom_behavior: slow push-in on mockups; punch-in on keyword reveals
overlays: optional brand logo ghost behind sticker
motion_graphics.borders: thick white sticker outline on cutouts; 1px hairlines inside UI cards
motion_graphics.gradients: none on canvas; soft shadow falloff only
motion_graphics.shadows: large soft diffuse shadow (y+12..24, blur 40..80, opacity ~0.18)

audio.bgm: optional light bed ducked under VO

hierarchy.visual_hierarchy: hero asset upper-mid → kinetic caption mid/lower → empty footer
hierarchy.emphasis_timing: caption words land with stressed syllables; lists reveal line-by-line

watermark.footer_policy: leave bottom 8% clear unless user supplies their own brand

notes: Clean-tech sticker explainer grammar. Original assets only. Never emit reference channel watermark.
